_about: The languages PhotoAgent offers besides Traditional Chinese (the source, zh-TW, ARB zh_Hant) and English (en, written in the code).
scripts/l10n_prepare.py makes each enabled language's catalogs from the doc repo's intl_<arb_locale>.arb; a language not listed here, or not enabled, is never offered, whatever ARB the doc repo has.
The key is the code the pages and the backend use (BCP 47, e.g. ja, pt-BR); arb_locale is the ARB file's locale (e.g. ja, pt_BR).

Required: arb_locale, name (the picker shows it, written in that language), prompt_name (what the model prompts call the language, in English) and format (every field of photo_agent/i18n.py SOURCE_FORMAT).
manual: the text with no letters that the Hub does not translate (arb-keys.json `manual`), keyed by the Chinese; a missing one falls back to English, then Chinese.
